description: Source code implementing AES-XTS encryption mode functions, including encryption, key initialization, control operations, and cipher structure definitions, based on OpenSSL and BoringSSL code.

methods.name: CRYPTO_xts128_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES-XTS encryption or decryption on input data.

methods.name: aes_xts_init_key
methods.description: Initializes the AES-XTS key context with provided key and IV.

methods.name: aes_xts_cipher
methods.description: Performs encryption or decryption using the AES-XTS cipher context.

methods.name: aes_xts_ctrl
methods.description: Handles control operations for the AES-XTS cipher context, such as copying context.

methods.name: EVP_aes_256_xts
methods.description: Defines the EVP cipher structure for AES-256-XTS mode.
